test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Sheetal always becoming nervous / whenever she gets instructions / from her Physics / teacher at the lab.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 3"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The erroneous part is the use of **"becoming" **in the continuous tense.
 
• Since the sentence is describing a habitual or repeated action, it should be in **the present tense.**
 
• So, the verb **"becoming"** should be changed to **"becomes"** to match the present tense context of the sentence.
 
• Hence, **"becomes"** should be used instead of** "becoming"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.

**Correct Sentence**: "Sheetal always **becomes**__ nervous whenever she gets instructions from her Physics teacher at the lab."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Certain words are always used in Perfect Tense: **“ever, never, yet, always, so far, recently etc."**

 
 
• ​**Example**: He had gone there **already**.
